disposition: hour-scale variability alias; trial period rejected as evidence for a temperate planet
evidence: The broad phase diagnostic shows repeating peaks and troughs every few hours throughout the purported out-of-transit interval. Lomb-Scargle finds a short period close to an integer subdivision of the trial period. Both SAP and PDC show this behavior.
limits: Origin of the variable flux is not localized. This does not establish intrinsic pulsation of the target star and does not rule out additional planets.
